purpose: Deterministic protocol and registry integration assertions; not a quality evaluation.
expected_assertions: Baseline config is captured in the company's private config store before publication.
Tournament compares baseline and candidate on the same fixture dataset and passes holdout and shadow gates.
Human review is an explicit deterministic test fixture and is not represented as a real review.
After publication, the next DataWorkflow analyze operation rebases the private company config and its candidate versions to the registry winner.
After registry rollback, the next DataWorkflow analyze operation rebases the private company config and candidate versions to baseline@1.
Existing tournament tests keep baseline on ties and reject ineligible or reused holdout runs.
not_proven: Semantic answer quality or a real-world quality gain.
Independent human labels or real-world holdout independence.
Production traffic behavior or an external Core onboarding integration.
